paragraphs: Week 12 (Nov 27 – Dec 1, Lectures 23 and 24) Teaching and Learning

8.5 Integration by partial fractions: all cases of partial fraction decompositions; method for finding the undetermined coefficients (including the Heaviside “cover-up” method); integration of each type of basic block in the decomposition.

8.7 Numerical integration: Trapezoidal rule; Simpson’s rule; error bounds (let us emphasize to the students that it is enough to have an idea about which method is more accurate in general --- no need to memorize the exact error bounds).
8.8 Improper integrals: two types of improper integrals (unbounded intervals and unbounded integrands); convergence tests (direct comparison and limit comparison).
it is OK to shuffle the contents above around in an order you prefer and feel free to add in your own stuff, so long as the non-optional topics are all covered.
